items.name: Sylhet Black
items.description: A rounded, copper-coloured cup with a soft malty finish. A generous morning tea, lovely on its own or with a little milk.

items.name: Assam Gold
items.description: Full-bodied and deep, with cocoa and raisin notes. Choose this tea when you want a rich breakfast cup that holds its own with milk.

items.name: Ilam Green
items.description: A light green tea with a sweet, nutty middle and a clean finish. Let the water cool a little to bring out its softer side.

items.name: Darjeeling First
items.description: A fragrant, bright cup with floral lift and a lively citrus edge. Best enjoyed without milk, in a quiet afternoon moment.

items.name: Nepal White
items.description: Soft, gently sweet leaves for a pale cup with pear and blossom notes. Use a generous pinch and give the leaves room to unfurl.

items.name: Bengal Green
items.description: A fresh, green cup with almond warmth and a little citrus at the finish. A clean-tasting companion to a slow afternoon.
